Issue: CORRECTED: “95–98% of wallet traffic” used the wrong denominator and omitted the strong observer setup. The study reports address-linking success in controlled experiments, not the share of all users exposed or identification of named people.
Recommended fix: Keep the corrected subtitle and visible experimental-scope qualification. Do not imply that UR (SN25) was tested or proven to prevent the attack.

Issue: OPEN — PUBLICATION HOLD: the monthly bars are sample data. The 350K headline, 126,717 providers and 103 countries are supplied/team-reported, not independently substantiated in this audit.
Recommended fix: Retain the requested placeholder in this review draft. Replace it with dated, defined and evidenced observations before public/client release.

Issue: OPEN: the critical proving-vulnerability assertion, v6 remediation, 200,000 staking threshold, 20% governance mint cap and November unlock are not primary-source verified in this audit. These can materially change the investment story.
Recommended fix: Obtain exact official disclosure, protocol/tokenomics and unlock references before external reliance. Remove or qualify any unsupported assertion.

Issue: CORRECTED: 96.8% was labelled “Ethereum, MetaMask” and described as a real-world experiment without identifying the testnet.
Recommended fix: Keep separate Ethereum mainnet (95.33%) and testnet (96.80%) rows, with MetaMask and three observations. Bitcoin/Electrum and Solana/Torus are testnet experiments with four observations.

Issue: CORRECTED: “independently measure” was inconsistent with the official launch documentation, which describes a UR-run operator and sole validator.
Recommended fix: Retain the launch qualification; describe independent validation as a design goal/assumption rather than an established launch property.

Issue: CORRECTED: approximately 200 fleets read as an observed count; it is a design capacity. The diagram’s standard emission allocation was not distinguished from launch provider allocation.
Recommended fix: Keep “Up to 200” and the design-capacity label. Keep the visible distinction between mechanism design and documented launch allocation.

Issue: CORRECTED: the text equated deposits with required new market buying. Official documentation says revenue-funded purchases are expected off-chain, not enforced.
Recommended fix: Describe token locking separately from net market purchases. Keep scenarios conditional on pricing, traffic and funding assumptions.

Issue: CORRECTED: speculative spending of the existing reserve conflicted with the one-way reserve design.
Recommended fix: State that the current reserve has no outbound transfer path. A future different architecture is not an existing holder right.

Issue: OPEN: supplied snapshots, company metrics, fees, revenue, fund-raising and peer values are not a fresh independently verified dataset. Broad publisher names are insufficient to reproduce each observation.
Recommended fix: Attach exact source URLs, observation dates, metric definitions and archived data extracts in the evidence register. Preserve the 15 October snapshot until the entire comparison is refreshed consistently.

Issue: OPEN: future court dates, unlock dates, product launches and roadmap status are retained from supplied research; this audit did not independently confirm them.
Recommended fix: Verify each against the official docket, announcement or release. Mark plans as conditional and date the status.

Issue: OPEN: device encryption, server retention, issuance reduction, DIEM economics and buyback rate remain supplied claims with secondary attributions.
Recommended fix: Check official product architecture, privacy policy and tokenomics. Do not conflate encrypted transport or non-retention with end-to-end confidential inference.

Issue: PARTLY CORRECTED: the refund example is now explicitly historical (2025). The official roadmap supports a planned linkability mitigation, not confirmation of its current rollout. The $1.5B figure remains supplied sponsored research.
Recommended fix: Confirm the original incident and current implementation separately. Keep sponsored-research attribution for the volume claim and do not present the historical example as a newly tested current flaw.

Issue: CORRECTED: the graphic could imply a calibrated crossover where operator buying exceeds emissions. No model or deposit rate was supplied.
Recommended fix: Keep the explicit illustrative/no-calibration statement and avoid using the crossover as a quantitative forecast.

Issue: OPEN ASSUMPTION: bear/base/bull ranges have no supplied cash-flow or deposit-based valuation model.
Recommended fix: Keep “illustrative assumptions” visible and in machine-readable outputs; supply assumptions and sensitivity analysis before treating ranges as targets.

Issue: OPEN INTERPRETATION: the chart cannot establish that token value capture caused different peer valuations. Market caps differ in supply, business models and risk.
Recommended fix: Treat the comparison as context, not causal proof. The 10× and 58× calculations are arithmetic comparisons, not expected returns.

Issue: CORRECTED: mixed UR, SN25 and SN25 UR labels made the project reference inconsistent.
Recommended fix: Use UR (SN25) for the project. Keep the distinct URnetwork product name and technical IDs/URLs unchanged.
Keep rounded wording around 1,000×, 10× and 58×; retain the snapshot date and illustrative qualification.
